steps.text: 10:30 A.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Cabin 4, Convalescent Garden

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: 'Scuse me~

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: 'Scuse meee, anyone in—

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hmmm?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Aw, man.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Nobody in? Morniiiing—Mooorniiiing—Just checkiiiiing—Anyone iiiiiiiin—! Halllll—looooooo—?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Huh, actually deserted.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: That's sucky.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Wasting my time somewhere empty-handed ain't my style. Hm-hmm, I'm here after all. Let's let your li'l Peter Pan of Lungmen, Rope, take a look, see what nice stuff's lying around...

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: ...Wait, no!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Claps face)

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Stoppit, stoppit, Rope. Pull it in. You can't do that.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Claps face) (Claps face)

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Ugh, what a scary habit to have.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: But you can't leave the door unlocked when no-one's in. That's just too sloppy. You can't blame anyone else when you lose something, okay?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: I swear I won't take anything. Just looking, looking...

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Just lemme looksie, scope what's good around here~

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hm? What's on the ground here... iunno. Who cares? Let's jump it!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hohoh, these flowers are real pretty with their colors. Dunno if they're worth anything...

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Oh, this ain't equipment you see everyday. Probably pretty expensive, huh?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: And over this way's... herbs?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hm? Hmm?? Whoooa, what IS this smell? This is pungent!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: I'm, I'm getting a little dizzy...

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Pteh—haah, close call!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Oh, crap, I thought I was about to faint. That was way too risky...!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: 'Better to jimmy open a Lungmen treasury box than charge an open door.' No wonder a mentor once said that. Kinda makes sense now.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Heh, okay, the joke ends here.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: If nobody's in, then I'm all hands tied. Wanted to do a little good for once, too. Whatevs.

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: I guess I'll just come next time—

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: What, I'm not the only one on the down-low?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hehey, now this is getting interesting. Wherever you came from, li'l dodger, let's have a duel~

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Pitter patter, sneakity skatter... position scoped, hook ready—

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Morning dew, peppermint, shaved ice showers♪

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Setting sun, jasmine, honey flowers♪

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hm-hmm~, hmm~, hm-hmm hm-hmm~~

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Uh, esscuse me...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And add just a little culture. Hmm, that should be a good amount!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: No, c'mon, you're way too focused.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And then mix it with the deep soil here. Oh, or perhaps add a little bit more plant ash?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm, this should do it just nicely!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Has she literally not noticed me? You need to keep your wits about you, y'know?)

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (And here I thought some thief actually got in. Eugh.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm... the balance still seems a little off. Last time's cultivar had balance issues too. Phew, let me think, what should I do...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Peat, akadama... maintain weak acidity...

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Still talking to herself. Is this, like, an okay situation?)

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Oh, but watching from the side is pretty fun~)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: That's right, how could I forget! I can try adding in some sandy soil brought from where it grew!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm, no matter plants or people, they're all best at home!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (Kind of makes sense to hear.)

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: (But y'know the sort who really work to flee the nest? Never wanna go back, those people? Uh, people? Plants? Whatever, same thing. There's plenty of them, right?)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Oh, now where did I put that soil again...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Not here, and not here. Hmm... how strange...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Wha-wha-wha?!

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: Huh? Huh??

steps.name: Rope
steps.text: What-what's wrong? What's up?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Eh? Ah...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Miss... Rope?
